philosophy: Profit-side exits are regime-dependent. Shadow-only until each regime has enough real evidence. One global TP/RSI is forbidden by default.
note: Source study: reports/EXIT_THRESHOLD_REGIME_STUDY_2026-08-06.md. SL (~3%) stays exchange-live everywhere. This map only shadows profit-side TP/trail and RSI hard-exit would-fires. No orders. operator_approve / take_profit.mode stay separate gates.
notify_note: OFF by default (Brad 2026-08-06): weekly status review, not per-episode Telegram. Still logs to state/events.

rsi_hard_exit.note: Shadow signal only; live still needs hard_exit.operator_approve false + live_apply

bull.label: Bull — bank gains; study favored ~6% TP vs SL-only

rsi_hard_exit.note: Higher bar in bull — avoid cutting strength early; still shadow-only

flat.label: Flat — earlier bank; study favored ~5% TP vs SL-only

rsi_hard_exit.note: Aligns with flat regime_cash overbought_rsi 65; shadow-only

bear.label: Bear — ride/SL prior for full TP; partial ladder is separate feature

rsi_hard_exit.note: Do not shadow-force RSI exits in bear until overturned

bear_profit_take.note: Partial ladder scale-out shadow only — not full TP; see FEAT-BEAR-PROFIT-TAKE

transition.label: Transition — conservative; no offline cell; default ride/SL + optional high RSI watch

promotion.note_calendar: Brad expectation: 1–2 months to cycle bull/bear/flat with enough points. Default gate 60d; 45d early review only if N gates met.
promotion.action_if_ready: Human review only. Per-regime: may enable that regime's knobs in a future live map. Global live TP or auto RSI hard-exit only if all required regimes ready + Brad OK. Never auto_promote.
